title: The 28 Percent Line: Who May Decide a Routine Journal?
subtitle: PEX finds only 28% of finance teams comfortable letting AI decide routine finance decisions. Deloitte says most CFOs expect AI cost and complexity to rise through 2027. Hub Group is restating three years after a $77 million error.
category: AI Control, Internal Control & CFO Judgment
description: HBS-style teaching case dated 15 September 2026. Public facts: PEX survey reported by CFO Dive (10 September 2026) — only 28% of finance teams comfortable having AI decide routine finance decisions. Deloitte survey via CFO.com — nearly two-thirds of CFOs expect AI-related costs and operational complexity to rise through 2027, yet many still prioritize the technology. Hub Group (14 September 2026, CFO Dive) named a CFO-elect and continues restating three years of financials after identifying a $77 million accounting error. Composite firm: Eastern Ports Logistics Ltd. Composite decision-maker: CFO Meera Rao.
thumbnail: ONLY 28% OF FINANCE TEAMS WILL LET AI DECIDE A ROUTINE JOURNAL. THE OTHER 72% STILL WANT A HUMAN ON THE LINE.
sources: CFO Dive, 'Finance teams still wary of giving AI control: PEX,' 10 September 2026.
CFO.com, 'CFOs expect AI costs to rise through 2027' (Deloitte survey), September 2026.

U.S. Bank CFO Insights Report, Spring 2026 (survey 19 March–14 April 2026, 1,000 senior finance leaders).

Philosophy: AI generates. DATA informs. FINANCE measures. ACCOUNTING verifies. HUMAN JUDGMENT decides.
